outcome: Factors associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding
cohort: 403 women who gave birth by cesarean section
finding: The magnitude of timely initiation of breastfeeding was low (47.4%) and was associated with attending four or more antenatal care visits, counseling during antenatal care, early skin-to-skin contact with newborn, post-delivery counseling, and getting assistance from health professionals.
